logtarget.description: Log target for fail2ban daemon output (file path or SYSLOG).

syslogfacility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog.

bantime.description: Default duration (seconds) a host remains banned.

findtime.description: Time window (seconds) during which failed attempts are counted.

maxretry.description: Maximum number of failures within `findtime` before banning.

backend.description: File monitoring backend (e.g., auto, inotify, polling).

mta.description: Mail transfer agent to use for email notifications.

destemail.description: Recipient email address for ban notifications.

sender.description: Sender email address in ban notifications.

sendername.description: Display name for sender in email notifications.

defaction.description: Default action taken when a host is banned (e.g., iptables-multiport, firewallcmd-whitelist).

sshd_logpath.description: Path to the SSH authentication log file.

sshd_maxretry.description: Per-jail override for max retry count for SSH.

sshd_bantime.description: Per-jail override for ban time for SSH.

sshd_findtime.description: Per-jail override for find time for SSH.

custom_jails.description: List of custom jails to define. Each jail includes name, filter, and logpath; other fields are optional.

filter.description: Name of the filter file (without .conf extension) used to detect failures.

logpath.description: Path to the log file to monitor.

maxretry.description: Override of maxretry for this jail.

bantime.description: Override of bantime for this jail.

findtime.description: Override of findtime for this jail.

action.description: Override of default action (e.g., 'iptables[name=HTTP, port=http, protocol=tcp]').
